Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this thrilling match. On Friday, 18th March 2022, Bangladesh Women, fresh from their historic win, will be taking on West Indies Women, who are on a 2-match losing streak. It promises to be another close game and will begin at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day). You can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sune Luus, the victorious captain of South Africa Women, says that she was going through a roller-coaster of emotions as they made it harder for themselves but she will take those two points. Mentions that they bowled brilliantly in Powerplay 1 and also praised Sophie Devine's knock. Luus sounds very happy with the way they bowled at the backend but chooses to ignore her own bowling show. On the chase, Sune Luus replies that they regrouped nicely after losing Lizelle Lee and feels that she along with Laura Wolvaardt should have finished the game. Lauds the batting effort of Marizanne Kapp. Further says that their next assignment is against Australia Women who are a very competitive team. Tells that there is not too much pressure on them and they will just look to improve on small things and go head.

Sophie Devine, the captain of New Zealand Women, starts by praising the bowling effort of Amelia Kerr whose two wickets shifted the momentum a bit towards the end. Feels that in such close games if you stay in, anything can happen. Shares that their plan was to keep out South Africa's strike bowlers as Shabnim Ismail and Marizanne Kapp can prove to be dangerous. She expresses her disappointment on the way they finished their batting innings. Talks about the importance of a set batter to finish the innings. Feels that they bowled a little too wide on that surface and calls it a learning curve for her team. Mentions that they need to move forward quickly and play well against England Women and she finds it interesting that so many teams are in the race for a top-four finish.

Marizanne Kapp gets the Player of the Match award! She picked up two wickets and played a match-winning knock towards the end. Smiles and says that these tight games should stop, she is tired now. Mentions that they bowled better against England and they got away with it in this match. States that their batters have been struggling and they want to come back stronger. Praises the knocks of Laura Wolvaardt and Sune Luus but mentions that you cannot afford to relax as things can change quickly and they luckily got over the line. States that she was not at her best with the ball and they need a few more people to stand up.
Presentation time...

Chasing an ordinary target of 229, South Africa Women started decently but the run out of Lizelle Lee allowed the White Ferns to put some pressure. The runs dried out and the knock of Tazmin Brits where she consumed too many dot balls put pressure on Laura Wolvaardt. The pair still combined for a 48-run stand to steady the ship and then Laura went on to stitch an 88-run stand with skipper Sune Luus. The chase appeared done and dusted but then Amelia Kerr led a fightback for New Zealand Women. She picked up a few wickets and the equation got quite close. Marizanne Kapp's presence though kept South Africa Women in the game and she eventually navigated her team home to maintain the winning streak.

New Zealand Women fought with blood and sweat. They would be hurting. This game got close and had they not experienced a batting collapse where they lost their last 6 wickets for only 30 runs, things could have been different this evening. The South African bowling blew hot and cold in the first half but was exceptional at the death and that performance has played a big role in handing them this victory.

Not a convincing one but a win nonetheless for South Africa Women and their juggernaut in this edition of the World Cup continues to roll. This is now their fourth win in a row and they certainly are trying their best to match the aura of invincibility of Australia Women. It was an easy chase for them, well-planned initially, although, towards the end, they felt the pressure of closing the game and lost quite a few wickets. It required the calm and cool head of Marizanne Kapp to see them home. The word 'choke' was about to come out on social media but South Africa Women have avoided that term, at least for now.
Phew, this edition of the World Cup has dished out yet another close match. South Africa Women have crossed the line eventually to get their first win over New Zealand Women in the 50-over World Cup.

It's all over! South Africa Women win and Ayabonga Khaka has done it! The emotions are running high and what a game we have witnessed here! It's pushed quicker on off by Frances Mackay, Ayabonga Khaka goes back and forces it towards the left of the mid off fielder. They run a quick single as the fielder misses her shy at the keeper's end. South Africa Women win by 2 wickets!
Pressure is written all over the face of Ayabonga Khaka.

Scores are level! On middle and fuller. Kapp works it towards deep mid-wicket and strangely takes a single. She has a word with Ayabonga Khaka, backing her to score the winning run. Will this backfire?

FOUR! This will surely seal the deal for South Africa Women! What an innings and what a shot under pressure. This is slower through the air on off. Kapp goes low and slog-sweeps it towards wide long on for a boundary. Just 2 needed now!
Right then, it has come down to the final over. 6 needed off 6. Can Frances Mackay do a Deandra Dottin? Marizanne Kapp is on strike...
So a single to end the over and Kapp will retain the strike! A full ball, on off. Kapp drills it to long off for a single. 6 needed from the last over!
FOUR! What a shot! Marizanne Kapp, you beauty! This is full, on off. Kapp goes inside-out over extra cover for a boundary. Just 7 needed now and Kapp is taking her team home yet again!

In the air...but it falls in the vacant area behind the bowler! Back of a length, around off, Ayabonga Khaka wants to finish this match with one blow. Swings her bat across the line, gets a top edge but it drops safely as the mid on and mid off fielders rush forward. The good thing for South Africa Women is that the batters have crossed and Marizanne Kapp is back on strike.
Play and a miss! Very full and wide outside off, Ayabonga Khaka tries to dig it out but fails.
Ayabonga Khaka walks in next. Marizanne Kapp will be regretting taking that second run on the first ball.

OUT! BOWLED! Shabnim Ismail took a risky route of going for a big shot with just run-a-ball needed and pays the price! Length delivery on middle and leg by Devine from 'round the wicket. Shabnim Ismail makes room and looks to hit it towards the off side. She misses and the ball shatters the stumps. Can Sophie Devine close this over with four good balls to create more drama?

The throw from the deep has hit Shabnim Ismail on the back of the helmet. The physio comes out to perform the mandatory concussion check. This delay will only add to the drama and tension. 12 needed off 11 balls.

Two runs to start the over! Lands this on a length, on off. Shabnim Ismail heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and comes back for a couple. The ball hits Shabnim Ismail on the back of the helmet as the throw comes in at the striker's end.
Sophie Devine to bowl the all-important 49th over.
Single to end the over! 14 needed from 12 balls as just 4 came from this over. This is fuller on middle. Shabnim Ismail skips down the track and works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Dot ball! A flatter and quicker delivery on middle. Ismail works it towards mid on.
Flatter delivery on middle. Kapp works it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

Appeal for a run out! Fuller and around off, skidding in, Shabnim Ismail pushes it down off the inner half to mid on. She calls for a run, Marizanne Kapp realizes late and then sets off. She has a near collision with the bowler as he scoots to the other end. There is a direct hit at the keeper's end. The third umpire is referred but Marizanne Kapp is safely in.
Quicker one, short and on middle, Marizanne Kapp goes on the back foot and punches it to long on for a run.
Shabnim Ismail walks in next. This is getting tense. 18 needed off 17 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Needless from Trisha Chetty and she pays the price for going for a big shot. This is slower in the air, on off. Chetty goes low and looks to slog-sweep it but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes high in the air and Frances Mackay takes a step back and settles under to take a fine catch near the stumps at the non-striker's end. This game is still not over folks!
So a good comeback by Lea Tahuhu! 18 needed now from 18 balls! This is on the shorter side around off. Kapp looks to guide it towards third man but misses.
Lands this full and outside off. Kapp goes chasing for it but misses. Two dot balls now.
Goes fuller on middle. Kapp drives it to mid on.

FOUR! Another short delivery and now South Africa are back as firm favourites! Shorter delivery on off. Kapp hangs on the back foot and pulls it firmly towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
FOUR! What a timely boundary by Kapp! Poor delivery this, back of a length, around leg. Kapp pulls it fine towards the long leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle, Chetty works it towards fine leg for a single.
Dot ball to end the over! Four runs from it and a valuable wicket! Tossed up on off. Kapp drives it back to the bowler. 27 needed off 24 balls!
Nicely bowled on off, slower in pace. Chetty tucks it towards square leg for a single.
A full toss on middle. Kapp drills it to long on for a single.
A full toss on middle. Chetty works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one, around leg, it's helped to mid-wicket for a single.
Trisha Chetty is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Ohh... Chloe Tryon what have you done! This is a big wicket for New Zealand Women and Chloe Tryon is furious with herself! This is tossed up on off and Tryon senses an opportunity to go for a big one. She dances down the track and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket region. But it's the bigger side of the ground and it goes straight down the throat of Amelia Kerr and she makes no mistake. This game is getting quite intense and tight!
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Frances Mackay

Commentary.Commentary: Eases this one through square leg and it's the end of a good over for South Africa Women. 8 from it, 31 needed off 30 balls.
Fuller and outside off, crunched through point for a single.
Angling down the leg side, full in length, Kapp fails to flick and it goes off her pads to square leg. Good calling and they get a couple of leg byes.
Fuller and outside off, slower in pace, Kapp pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Up and just over mid off! Back of a length around off, Kapp stands tall and tries to launch it across the line. It takes the top edge and just clears Devine. They take two.
A low full toss around leg, Kapp whips it off her pads to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Hannah Rowe has finished her spell. So Lea Tahuhu is back into the attack now. She has bowled 7 overs so far and has given away 29 runs. Can she break this partnership?
Loopy and very full on middle, Marizanne Kapp knocks it down to long on for a run. 39 needed off 36 balls.
Walks forward and strokes it to mid off. Sophie Devine makes a half stop and they collect one.

Flatter and shorter around off, Chloe Tryon goes back and punches it to extra cover where Suzie Bates makes a sliding stop. They cross and the throw from her is a wayward one. Well over the keeper and they take another run.
Very full and outside off, Marizanne Kapp drills it down to long on for one.
Works it with the spin through square leg for a single.

Stumping chance missed! Floated and full, around middle, Chloe Tryon skips down the track and attempts to heave but misses. Katey Martin fails to collect the ball due to the extra bounce and Chloe Tryon gets a life. Costly miss at this stage.
Slower one, full and around off, Chloe Tryon helps it off the inside edge to mid-wicket for a single. Hannah Rowe is done with her spell, 10-0-32-1!
PLAY AND A MISS! Rowe goes short again, around off, Tryon bends her back knee and tries to swat it but misses.
Full toss on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Pace off, full again around middle, Kapp pushes it to mid on. Dot.
Fullish and on middle, Chloe forces it down the ground for a single as the mid on fielder cuts it off.
Slower bouncer on middle, Kapp is early into the pull shot. It takes the inner half, deflects onto the body and goes to the leg side. They cross.
Flighted and around off, Marizanne Kapp kneels down and slogs it over mid-wicket. It doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep and they collect a single. 9 from the over, 49 needed off 48 balls.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through extra cover for a single.
Wristy! Loopy and full, around off, Kapp chips it over mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and around off, Kapp gets back and pushes it back to the bowler. Frances Mackay doesn't collect but parries it to mid off.
Again it's very full around middle, Tryon knocks it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap and this boundary will ease some pressure. Too full in length outside off, Chloe Tryon drills her drive and beats the cover fielder inside the ring for a boundary.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, left alone.
Frances Mackay is back into the attack now. She has given 20 runs in her four overs so far.
Fuller and around off, driven through point for a single. The required rate has gone above 6 now.
Ohh...close! Back of a length, around off. Tryon looks to cut it away but gets the inside edge and it goes just past the stumps.
Fullish delivery on off. Tryon drives it to the cover fielder in the ring.
A full delivery on off. Tryon drives it to covers.
Around off, on a length, Tryon taps it down to point.
Chloe Tryon is the next batter in. She can hit the ball hard but will she be able to handle the pressure here?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Game on, Sune Luus is gone and it's game on now! Hannah Rowe has earned the prized scalp and this match is heading towards a thrilling finish now. Nothing special with the delivery. It's served on a fuller length outside off, Sune Luus tries to drive but gets a feather behind to the keeper and Katey Martin gets yet another dismissal to her name in this match. 59 needed off 59 balls. The replays showed that it was a slower one and credit goes to Hannah for deriving that false shot.
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Hannah Rowe

Commentary.Commentary: Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 25-yard circle till the end of this inning. 59 needed more.
Just two from this over! End of a brillaint spell from Amelia Kerr! Tossed up nicely on off. Kapp drives it to covers. 59 needed from 60 balls now!
Tossed up nicely on off now. Kapp leans forward and drives it to mid off.
Ohh..close, a leading edge! Flatter delivery on middle. Kapp looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge back to the bowler off the bounce.
Fuller delivery on middle. Kapp pushes it to mid on.
Goes fuller on off. Luus drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter and shorter delivery on middle. Kapp works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
So another good over for White Ferns! 61 needed now from 66 balls. This is served on length, on off. Luus pushes it towards point.
Another dot ball! A length delivery, on off. Luus pushes it towards covers.
Slower in pace and fuller on off. Luus looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto the pads.
A fullish delivery on middle. Luus works it towards mid-wicket.
Bangs this one short on middle. Luus pulls it towards the backward square leg region. Green runs to her right and stops it with a dive. Fifty up for the skipper but the job is not done yet!
Very full delivery on middle. Luus plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller and wide outside off, it's driven down to mid off. 63 needed now from 72 balls!
Tossed up, around off, stroked off the front foot to covers.

Beauty! Drift in the air, grip and turn with extra bounce. Marizanne Kapp gets forward to drive but misses. Amelia Kerr has started to get some assistance now. She has 8 balls remaining in her spell, South Africa Women would look to play her out safely.
Marizanne Kapp is the new batter. 63 needed off 75 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Amelia Kerr gets another one and New Zealand Women are still in it! This is flatter and outside off, slightly shorter in length too. Mignon du Preez looks to cut but the ball catches the outside edge of her blade and Katey Martin behind the stumps takes a sharp catch. Amelia Kerr is turning it on for New Zealand, is there a twist in the tale?
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off. Mignon du Preez pushes it towards covers.
Well bowled! This is nicely tossed up around off. It turns away a bit and beats the outside edge of Luus' blade. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a bye is taken.
Short and wide outside off. Sune Luus cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. 64 needed now from 78 balls.
A single taken, good running! Lands this on a length, on off. Mignon du Preez pushes it towards point and takes a quick single.
A low full toss on middle. Mignon du Preez works it towards mid-wicket. A dot ball now.
Angles this length delivery on middle. Luus works it to deep square leg for a single.
Rowe goes short outside off. Luus cuts it to cover-point. Good fielding there.
Wide! Short and quite wide outside off, Luus lets it be.
Fuller and around off, Sune drives it to covers.
Tossed up around off, Mignon du Preez lunges and defends it to the off side.
Mignon du Preez, playing her 150th ODI, walks in next. 68 needed off 85 balls

OUT! LBW! Amelia Kerr does the trick and New Zealand Women have finally broken through and dangerous Laura Wolvaardt walks back to the pavilion. This is flatter and pitches around leg. Laura Wolvaardt gets across and looks to work it towards the leg side. She misses and the ball hits her pads and there is a big appeal from the bowler. The umpire raises the finger. Laura Wolvaardt takes the review but the UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows three reds, so the original decision stays and New Zealand Women get an important breakthrough.
DRS time! Laura Wolvaardt has been adjudged lbw and she has decided to review the decision. Three reds on the Ball Tracking and Laura is gone. New Zealand Women have an opening now.
A fuller delivery on middle. Luus sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ohh...a lovely delivery! Pitches on off and turning away. Luus looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes shorter outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up nicely on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it towards backward point.
Full this time, around off and angling in, it's defended to covers. 70 needed off 90 balls.
Well stopped at point! Short and wide outside off, Sune cracks it off the back foot but the point fielder dives across to her right to stop the racing ball.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Luus tries to flick but misses.
Fuller and around off, Luus pushes it off her front foot to covers.
Short again, around middle, this time it has been pulled to deep square leg for a run.
Swing and a miss! back of a length, around middle, Laura Wolvaardt stands back to pull but misses.
Nearly chops it on! Hannah Rowe delivers it full and around off, Sune tries to work it away but gets an inside edge past the stumps to fine leg. A single is taken.

Drinks! South Africa Women are going about their business in quite a clinical fashion. The required rate is under five and with 8 wickets in hand, things are looking rosy for them. White Ferns need wickets and need them quickly to garner any hopes of winning this game. They need a moment of inspiration from somewhere as these two batters are looking mighty comfortable in the middle. Do we have a twist in the tale or will South Africa Women cruise towards another victory? Let's find out. Hannah Rowe comes back into the attack.
On a good length around off, Laura Wolvaardt stays back to hit it across the line but finds mid-wicket. 6 from the over, 73 needed off 96 balls.
Kerr goes short and around middle, it's pulled to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Slower one, full and outside off, Sune Luus waits for it to drop in her zone and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Short and around off, Sune cuts but finds the cover-point fielder.
Edged away! In the channel outside off, on a fuller length, again Laura tries to drive but this time she gets some bat on it. It flies off the edge to third man and she gets a run.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length and outside off, Laura tries to drive but is beaten on the outside edge.
Lands it on a length around off, cramping the batter for room, Luus cuts it from the crease to point. 79 needed more off 102 balls.
FOUR! Easy pickings! 150 up for South Africa Women! Lea Tahuhu again goes short but this time the line is down the leg side, Sune Luus swivels and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Serves it short and wide outside off, Sune slaps it through the line but the cover-point fielder dives to make the stop.
A cutter around off, on a length, Luus pushes it down towards mid on.
Digs it in short, around off, Sune leans back and allows it through. The thought of playing the ramp shot could have crossed her mind but she doesn't want to do anything fancy.
On a length, around middle and leg, Laura Wolvaardt clips it off her pads to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish and around off, Laura Wolvaardt forces her drive to covers where the fielder dives and makes a partial stop. They cross for a run. 84 needed more.
Short again, around off, Sune pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
A touch short and on off, Luus stands back and taps it down to point.
Around off, on a good length, Sune goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
Width available outside off and it has been eased down to third man for a single.
Play and a miss! Jess starts a new spell with a very full ball outside off, Laura tries to drive but misses.
Change. Jess Kerr (5-0-14-0) is brought back into the attack.
Dot ball to end the over, 87 needed more. Fuller and on off, defended to covers.
Short again, outside off, Laura jumps and slams it over covers for a single.
Short and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt drops her wrists and allows it through.
Pitches it up and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt drives but finds the cover fielder.
On a length around middle and leg, Laura tries to flick but misses.
Back of a length outside off, Laura Wolvaardt steers it through point for a couple of runs.
Flatter and shorter on off, Luus defends it from the back foot to the off side. 10 from the over, 90 needed off 120 balls.
Extra loop on this delivery as it lands full around off, Laura drives it to sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! A long hop on middle, an attempted googly, Laura Wolvaardt goes deep inside the crease and clobbers it in the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller on off. Luus drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! No real risk taken again, but still a boundary for Luus! This is tossed up outside off. Luus drives this off the outside half of her blade. The ball goes through to the third man region for a boundary.
Tossed up nicely on off. Luus drives it to covers.
Goes fuller on off. Luus drives it towards mid off and takes a quick single. Exactly 100 needed now for South Africa Women!
A full toss on off. Luus drives it to deep extra cover for a couple.
Goes wide of the crease and serves this full on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Devine opting for a short delivery again, it is outside off. Laura Wolvaardt lets it go.
Pulls the length back a bit. On leg and Luus works it towards fine leg for a single.
A fullish delivery on middle. Luus drives it to mid on.
WIDE! Bouncer on middle. Luus ducks under it. The umpire calls it wide for height.
A touch short and around off, Laura goes back and waits for the ball to spin away. She plays late and guides it wide of short third man for two. 9 from the over. The 50-run stand has come up now!

FOUR! Streaky! Luck this time for Laura Wolvaardt and it's another fifty for the opener. She has been the glue of this batting line-up. Tossed up outside off, Laura Wolvaardt drives but gets a thick outside edge. The ball runs past the gully fielder and scoots towards the third man region for a boundary. Third fifty in a row for Laura Wolvaardt and she continues her merry way in this tournament!
Shorter outside off. Luus pushes it to sweeper cover for an easy single.
A half-tracker on off. Laura Wolvaardt goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air and on the shorter side again, outside off. Luus pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Amelia Kerr serves this short and on off. Luus goes back and cuts it to point.
Amelia Kerr gets a change of ends.
Bangs this one short on off. Laura Wolvaardt sways away from the line of the ball.
Goes fuller on leg. Luus works it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Lands this on a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt taps it towards cover-point and takes a single.
Serves it full again and this time outside off, Sune drives it through covers for a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Offers width outside off, short in length, Laura forces it from the toe end of the bat to deep cover for a single.
Sophie Devine brings herself back into the attack.
Shorter on off. Laura Wolvaardt pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A flighted delivery on middle. Luus works it through mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards the backward square leg region for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it towards short mid-wicket.
Googly this time, it pitches on off and comes into the batter. Luus works this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A short-length delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven with the spin to point. 9 from the over, 124 needed at the halfway stage.

FIVE WIDES! Kerr loses her radar and slips a full ball down the leg side, Sune Luus fails to sweep and it takes the pads of Katey Martin, the keeper, on its way to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs for South Africa Women!
Play and a miss! Quicker one, short and outside off, the batter tries to cut but misses.
100 up! Again the length is short outside off and it has been forced through covers for one.
Flatter and shorter around off, a googly, Luus punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short again, on middle, Laura pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Sune wants the second run but is sent back.
A long hop, around off and turning away, Sune punches it to deep cover for a single.
Too full and on off, Laura flicks but finds short mid-wicket. Five singles from the over!
Full and flighted on off, Sune inside-edges her attempted flick behind square leg. Another single.
A touch short and on off, Laura Wolvaardt goes back and nurdles it wide of short fine leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, eased past the bowler to long on for another single.
A touch short and on off, Laura cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Flighted and full, around off, it's knocked down to long on for an easy single.
Frances Mackay is back on. She has given 10 runs in two overs she has bowled so far.
Drifting down the leg side, Sune Luus gloves her attempted pull shot to this short delivery to fine leg. A single is taken.
Fuller and on off, Sune defends it to covers.
On middle, defended to mid-wicket.

EDGY! Lea Tahuhu goes short and around middle and leg, Laura Wolvaardt takes a late decision to pull, has her back leg bent as she wheels her willow. It flies off the top edge and goes down to fine leg. Falls safely and they cross for a run.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Boom! Short in length and wide outside off, Sune Luus latches onto it and smashes it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller and wider outside off, Laura Wolvaardt drives and the backward point fielder makes a diving stop.

Whoa! That would have been a bizarre dismissal. Short in length around off, Laura Wolvaardt goes back to pull against the turn and gets a bottom edge. It strikes her on the left boot and deflects behind, beating the off stump by a whisker. Lucky escape for Laura!
Floated and full, around off, Laura Wolvaardt slices her drive to short third man.
A touch short and on off, Sune goes on the back foot and forces it to deep cover for a single.
Too full again, outside off, Sune drives but finds the point fielder.
Loopy and full around off, Sune drives it in the gap at sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Width there, short and wide outside off, Luus slaps it to deep cover-point for a single. The asking rate has climbed over 5 now.
Effort delivery, a bouncer around off, Sune Luus ducks.
Fuller and on middle, it's driven back to the bowler.
Sliding down the leg side, Laura Wolvaardt nudges it to long leg for a run.
A bumper around off, Laura shows no intention to play at it.
Back of a length around off, Laura stays back and plays it down to point.
Fuller and on off, pushed in the gap at cover-point for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it towards backward point.

Ohh...this time an outside edge but Martin fails to grab it! This is tossed up, outside off and spinning away. Laura Wolvaardt goes for a drive again, this time she gets the outside edge. The ball goes back to the keeper who is late in reacting. It hits Katey Martin on the right thigh and goes down. A chance missed.
Flatter and quicker outside off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes forward to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower in the air and shorter outside off. Luus pushes it towards backward point for a single.
Fuller delivery on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bit of shape away from the batter. Lands this on a length, around off and Luus defends this off the outside half of her blade as it swings away a bit.
Pitches this one up, on off. Luus drives it crisply through covers and gets a couple as the fielder cuts it off.
Serves this on a length again, on off. Luus calmly defends it.
Lands this on a length, on middle. Luus defends it towards the leg side.
Lands it on a fuller length around off, Sune Luus defends it by getting forward.
Fuller and around off, Sune defends it to covers.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards square leg for a single.
Skipper Sune Luus walks in next.

OUT! STUMPED! A classic leg spinner's wicket, this! Amelia Kerr tosses this up in the air, around off. Brits skips down the track and then looks to defend it as she fails to reach the pitch of the ball. However, the ball turns away and beats the outside edge of her blade. Martin, behind the stumps, collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. They appeal, it's referred and the replays find Tazmin Brits short of the crease. Also, it appears that Amelia Kerr had sensed the charge and that's why she shortened the length slightly. Great anticipation. 156 needed off 193 balls.
Commentary.Howout: st Katey Martin b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal! Tazmin Brits looks to be a goner. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the outside edge but finds nothing on the UltraEdge. The side-on angle finds that Brits is well short of the crease.
Slower in the air, outside off. Brits leaves it alone.
Tossed up and slower in the air. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it towards the off side for a single.
Shorter length delivery on off. Brits hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter and slightly shorter delivery on off. Brits punches this back to the bowler.
A length delivery on middle. Brits works it past square leg for a single.
FOUR! SHOT!  This is full on off. Brits takes a step or two forward and just lifts it over mid on for a boundary. She is getting a move on now.
Back of a length, on off. Brits pushes this towards the off side.
Bangs this one short on middle. Brits pulls it towards mid-wicket.

WIDE! Fuller and down the leg side. Brits skips down the track and looks to clip it away but misses. The keeper collects the ball and throws it towards the stumps at her end. Misses. The bowler is unaware and the ball goes past her to mid off.

Huge appeal for an lbw but the umpire turns it down! New Zealand decide not to take the review. Lands this on a length, on middle and leg. Brits looks to defend but is beaten for pace. The ball hits her pads but it is going down leg.
Serves this on a length, around off. Laura Wolvaardt opens the face of her blade and guides it towards third man for a single.

Drinks break. This match is tightly poised at the moment. South Africa Women had started positively but after the run out of Lizelle Lee, things have slowed down. Laura Wolvaardt is looking in fine touch but Tazmin Brits has consumed too many deliveries to build unnecessary pressure. She found a couple of boundaries in the previous over and that probably will break the shackles. The asking rate though is still under 5 and perhaps, they are just trying to absorb the pressure at the moment. The next phase will decide which way this chase is heading.
Leg spinner this time, outside off and turning away. Brits leaves it alone.
Googly that pitches on middle and turns towards leg. Brits looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits her high on the pads.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Brits lets it go this time.
FOUR! Another boundary now! This is fuller on off. Brits reverse-sweeps it through the backward point region for a boundary. Looks like she was just waiting for Amelia Kerr.
FOUR! First boundary for Brits and finally she breaks the shackles! Tossed up on off. Brits skips down the track and hammers it straight down the ground for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it past square leg for a single.
Time for some leg spin now. Amelia Kerr is into the attack.
Hurls a length ball in the channel outside off, Tazmin Brits shoulders arms.
Fuller in length and outside off, hit square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Angling down the leg side, nudged to deep backward square leg for a run.
Fuller again, around off, Tazmin Brits stays back and defends it to mid on. Brits has played plenty of dots here, batting at a striker rate just above 13.
Pitches it up and outside off, Wolvaardt drives it to deep cover for a single.
Fractionally short in length, on top of off, Laura goes on her toes and plays it down to point.
Lea Tahuhu is brought into the attack now. New Zealand's fastest bowler!
Fuller and on middle, Laura knocks it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, around leg, it's eased away past square leg for one.
Fullish and around off, pushed down to mid off.
50 up for South Africa Women! Fuller and around off, Laura drives it to mid off and scampers across to the other end.

NOT OUT! Fullish and on middle, Laura drills it straight back and Devine goes down low to stop the ball. It appears to have brushed her fingers and goes on to collide with the stumps at the other end. A polite enquiry from the bowler and it's referred upstairs. The third umpire watches the replays closely and finds that there was no touch from Sophie Devine.
Appeal for a run out at the non-striker's end...
Around off, on a length, Lauran helps it away to short mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Laura pierces the gap at covers with her drive but only for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Short in length and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt climbs onto it and whacks it through point for a boundary.
Too full in length around off, Laura drives it past the short cover fielder but the other fielder at the edge of the circle stops it with a dive.
Bouncer around off, Laura Wolvaardt picks it late and decides to sway away at the last moment.
Pitches it up and around off, Laura drives it through the line but finds the cover fielder at the edge of the circle.
Wide! Back of a length, around leg and angling down, Laura Wolvaardt tries to work it away but misses.
Uses the angle of the bowler and pushes a full ball down towards mid on.
Fuller in length, around off and angling in, Brits offers a straight bat in defense.
Too full in length and outside off, slower in pace, Laura digs it out towards mid off.
FOUR! Classy! Fuller delivery, around off, Laura Wolvaardt leans into the drive and caresses it through extra cover for a delightful boundary.
A low full toss around leg, it's whipped behind square leg for one.
A low dipping full toss around off, Tazmin pushes it down off the bottom part of the willow to mid off.
Sophie Devine brings herself into the attack now.
Fuller delivery, wide outside off, Tazmin reaches out and drives but finds the cover fielder.
Fullish and on off, driven back to the bowler off the toe end of the bat.
Slower one, on a length and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt shapes up for a big shot but then has to pull out. It takes the inner half of her blade and drops on the surface.
Fuller this time, holding up a bit off the surface, Laura Wolvaardt checks her shot and pushes it away to mid off again.
A low dipping delivery, a near-yorker on off, Laura Wolvaardt eases it out to mid off.

FOUR! Plenty of power on this shot and this will ease the pressure slightly. Fuller in length and on middle, Laura Wolvaardt brings her bottom hand into play and drills it wide of mid on for a boundary.
On a good length and around off, Laura Wolvaardt plays it from the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Another dot delivery and Brits has now scored just one run from 15 balls! Fullish delivery on off. Brits drives it to mid off. South Africa Women are 33/1 after Powerplay 1.
Serves this fuller on off. Brits drives it to extra cover.
Another dot ball and Brits is not helping her team and the partner at the other end. A good-length delivery, around off. Brits looks to push it away but misses.
Lands this on a length, on middle. Brits works it towards the leg side.
Tailing into middle and leg. Laura Wolvaardt looks to work it away but misses. The ball hits her pads and a leg bye is taken as the ball deflects towards short fine leg.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side. Laura Wolvaardt looks to clip it but misses.
Fullish delivery and tailing into Laura Wolvaardt, on off. She drives it back to the bowler.
No run off the bat in this over! Lands this on a length, on off. Brits blocks it out.
Another dot ball! This is fullish delivery on middle. Brits works it towards short mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter on off. Brits punches it to mid on. Dot balls and pressure is building.
Serves this on a length, on middle. Brits works it towards mid-wicket.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Brits leaves it alone.
Hits the length hard, on off. Brits blocks it out.
WIDE! This is fuller and down the leg side. Brits looks to clip it but misses.
Goes fuller and outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it towards backward point.
Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it to point.
This one holds on the surface a bit! Back of a length, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt is early into her shot and ends up nudging it uppishly towards mid-wicket. Off the bounce to the fielder.
Drifting on the pads, on middle and leg. Brits works it towards fine leg for a single.
Pulls her length back and serves this around off. Brits pushes this towards the off side off the back foot.
Fullish delivery on off. Brits drives this off the front foot to mid off.
Short and wider outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it well but hits this straight to the fielder at point.
Goes slightly short, on off. Laura Wolvaardt rides the bounce and blocks it out.
This is a full toss on leg. Laura Wolvaardt looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto her pads.
Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt goes back and punches it to covers.
FOUR! Crunched away! Hannah Rowe feeds room outside off, short and wide, Laura Wolvaardt latches onto it and smacks it through cover-point for a boundary. That's aerial but in the gap.
Lands it on a length and close to off, straightening off the seam, Laura Wolvaardt defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers. Dot ball to end a successful over.
Around middle, on a length, it's pushed down to mid on off the inner half.
Tazmin Brits is the number 3 batter.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ohh...this is disastrous for South Africa Women. They were looking so good but Lee has to walk back now in a bid to steal the third run. This is served fuller on off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it through covers and the batters take two. Suzie Bates has chased it down in the deep and now Laura Wolvaardt wants the third run on the throw. Lizelle Lee never looked ready for the third run but then decides to respond to the call. Meanwhile, in the deep, Bates parries it to Sophie Devine, an excellent tag-team effort and the skipper fires in a flat but weak throw to the keeper. Now, here is the brilliance and smart thinking from Katey Martin. She realizes that the throw won't get to her in time and hence collects the ball ahead of the stumps and flicks it to dislodge the bails. Lizelle Lee has put in a dive to get in but looks to be in trouble. The third umpire is referred and the replays find Lee short of the crease. Matter of a microsecond, had Lee responded a bit early she would have made it safely, also had Martin not collected the ball ahead of the stumps, that would have given Lee some extra time to get in.
Appeal for a run out! Lizelle Lee is looking in trouble here. Gone!
Serves this on a length again, on off. Lee nudges it towards the leg side for another single.
Pulls her length back a little. On middle and Laura Wolvaardt works it towards square leg for a single.
Jess Kerr delivers this full and gets a bit of shape into the batter from around off. Lee pushes it towards covers for a single.
The line becomes straighter and the length is fuller, Laura Wolvaardt picks it up off her pads and whips it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Wide! Short again and this time it's way wide outside off, Laura leaves.
Short and wide outside off, cut through the line off the back foot but straight to the point fielder.
Fuller and around middle, straightening a bit off the seam, Laura Wolvaardt drives it off the outer half of the blade to covers.
On a length and outside off, shaping away again, Laura Wolvaardt pushes it a bit uppishly but wide of mid off.
Short in length and outside off, shaping away, Laura goes on her toes and plays it down to cover-point.
Starts with a length ball, angling in around middle, Laura Wolvaardt stays on the back foot and defends it towards mid on.
So Plan A has not worked for New Zealand Women and they are now going for Plan B. Frances Mackay's two-over spell is over and Hannah Rowe is into the attack now.
Fuller and around off, curving back in, Lizelle Lee defends it by bringing her bat and pad together. It rolls back to the bowler off the inner half of the blade.
Up and over the infield! Fuller in length, outside off and shaping in, Lee takes the aerial route and lofts it over mid off. Not connected well but good enough for a couple of runs.
A bit short in length and around off, Lee hangs on the back foot and turns it on the leg side, finds short mid-wicket.
Gets on the front foot this time, to a full ball around off, and defends it watchfully.
Some movement in the air and off the pitch. It lands on a length around off, shaping in, Lee defends it from the back foot.
Jess bowls it full and around off, angling in, Lizelle Lee defends it to the off side.
Quick single. Spinning back in from around off, Lee nudges it towards mid-wicket and keeps strike with herself.
Loopy and full around off, defended firmly to covers.
Nicely tossed up, landing very full around off, Lizelle Lee brings her bat down to defend but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. They take two.
FOUR! Through the gap! Frances Mackay pulls her length back a shade, it's around off and Lizelle Lee immediately goes deep inside the crease as she whacks it through covers for a boundary.
Edgy! Tossed up, full and outside off, Lee tries to drive but it takes the outer half and goes to backward point.
Loopy delivery, full and outside off, it's stroked to deep cover for a single.

FOUR! Creamed away! A little too full on this occasion plus there is width available outside off, Lizelle Lee presses on the front foot and drives it elegantly through covers for a boundary - first of the chase.
Fuller again, around off, Lizelle Lee pushes it back to the bowler.
Jess Kerr pitches it up again, fuller and on off, shaping in, Lee is forward as she defends it from the inner half to mid-wicket.
Pitches it up and around off, Lee gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Again there is width outside off, on a good length, Laura Wolvaardt cuts it from the back foot, past the point fielder for a single.
Jess Kerr begins her spell with a delivery on a length outside off, Laura Wolvaardt reaches out and plays it down to point.
Jess Kerr will start from the other end. So the combination of spin and seam for New Zealand Women to start.
Turning down the leg side, it's eased behind to backward square leg where the fielder misfields and allows a couple of runs. South Africa Women are underway!
Turn and bounce, from middle, Lizelle Lee fails to work it around and is hit on the pads.
Leading edge! Floated one, full and around off, not spinning much, Lizelle Lee tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It takes the leading edge and rolls away to covers.
Fuller and on off, defended back.
Slower through the air, a touch short and around off, Lee pushes it down to mid on.
Starts with a tossed-up delivery around off, Lizelle Lee gets on the front foot and defends it to covers.
